observability_triage.rationale: Connector availability, recurring stock risk, and existence of purchasable compatible alternatives are time-varying supplier facts. The frozen KiCad artifacts can expose the selected footprint and pinout but contain no dated supplier snapshot, approved alternative MPN list, or compatibility evidence.
repair_requirements: Freeze a dated AliExpress/supplier inventory snapshot with product identifiers and stock state.
Freeze an approved alternative-MPN compatibility table covering footprint, pinout, USB data capability, voltage/current ratings, and mechanical envelope.

evidence: The network-disabled pre-repo exposes no supplier data artifact.
The KiCad component value and footprint cannot prove future or recurring inventory availability.
No compatible-alternative MPN list or equivalence criteria are frozen.
missing_observables: Dated stock status for the selected USB-C connector

minimum_environment_repairs: Add hashed supplier snapshots and a machine-readable alternative-part compatibility fixture.
Define the observation date/window and recurring-availability threshold.
blocker_or_exclusion.reentry_condition: Re-author criteria when supplier availability and alternative compatibility are frozen, hash-bound inputs that can be joined to the selected KiCad connector MPN.
